purpose: Bounded real-adapter qualification; full geometries stay in /tmp and repository samples contain at most three features.
scope: Old Bazaar published parcel layer only; KP and Parcela values may be blank; OID is transport and source-scoped native key. Sopstvenost is deliberately excluded.
privacy: Only parcel identity/reference, lifecycle, and administrative class fields listed by the descriptor are queried. No owner fields.

metricShapelyAudit.projector: Node proj4 backend dependency; Shapely 2.1.2 / GEOS 3.13.1
metricShapelyAudit.sampleScope: All unique source geometries returned in the bounded city window cells in this acceptance run.

sourceGeometryDiagnosis.method: Fresh exact-identity ArcGIS REST refetch of the previously flagged features in native spatial reference and outSR=4326. Native and WGS84 geometries were measured in the local metric CRS; no repair, clipping, or filtering was applied. Areas/fractions are approximate. Maximum inscribed diameter measures the largest disk in polygonal overlap area; line-only contact excluded.
sourceGeometryDiagnosis.statusGrouping: All exact OID reads HTTP 200. The only nonblank parcel label is Dance (OID 272); KP and Br_Blok are null throughout. No lifecycle/status field is exposed, so identity is source-scoped by service and OID only.
sourceGeometryDiagnosis.projectionComparison: Native EPSG:32634, outSR=32634, outSR=4326, GeoJSON default and GeoJSON outSR=4326 retained 22/23/5/8/5 vertices; overlaps remained the same after transformation within measurement precision.
sourceGeometryDiagnosis.overlapPattern: OID 449 and 464 are coincident 5-vertex polygons. Both are fully covered by OID 452; the latter polygon has area about 35.9615 m2. OID 272/273 has only a sub-millimetre-wide sliver.
